documents.text:
Fabric MCP 1.4.0 renamed docs_workload-api-spec to docs_item-api-spec and the required workload-type argument to item-type. Unknown parameters are now explicitly rejected. These real hyphenated property names must be preserved; underscore aliases are not accepted. The selected workflow retrieves bundled public API documentation without authentication. The separate docs_workloads -> docs_list-item-types response rename workloads -> itemTypes is recorded as public provenance, not claimed as covered by this API-spec trial.
Public repository: https://github.com/microsoft/mcp
Old release: Fabric.Mcp.Server-1.3.0 (4828227fcf11fcae80794ff4620897160d32d583)
New release: Fabric.Mcp.Server-1.4.0 (d638fefa0c98b91916da81a694035f5fe4625f5b)
https://github.com/microsoft/mcp/blob/d638fefa0c98b91916da81a694035f5fe4625f5b/servers/Fabric.Mcp.Server/CHANGELOG.md
No gate, native control or sealed observations are included.

newContracts.description: Retrieves the complete OpenAPI specification for a specific Microsoft Fabric item type. Use this when the user needs detailed API documentation for an item type such as notebook, lakehouse or report. Returns the full API spec in JSON format.

item-type.description: The Microsoft Fabric item type (e.g. 'notebook', 'lakehouse', 'dataPipeline', 'report', 'warehouse'). Also accepts a few non-item areas: 'platform' and 'admin' (platform and tenant APIs), 'spark' (workspace Spark settings), and 'realTimeIntelligence' (workload-level copilot APIs). Call the 'list-item-types' tool for the full list of supported values.

newContracts.name: docs_item-api-spec

oldContract.description: Retrieves the complete OpenAPI specification for a specific Fabric workload. Use this when the user needs detailed API documentation for a workload like notebooks or reports. Returns full API spec in JSON format.

workload-type.description: The type of Microsoft Fabric workload.

oldContract.name: docs_workload-api-spec
